# Navimower Map Card 0.3.0-beta7

## Visual-editor hotfix

This prerelease removes the manual HEX text fields introduced in beta5 and restores the native Home Assistant color controls used by beta4.

The removed editor layer wrapped `getConfigForm()`, `getStubConfig()`, and `setConfig()`. Home Assistant can supply immutable configuration and schema objects, so that layer could trigger `Cannot assign to read only property 'type' of object '#<Object>'` while opening or rendering cards in dashboard edit mode.

## Cache-safe beta module

The remaining delayed schedule-save confirmation is moved to a new beta-specific module:

- `navimower-map-card-v034b7.js`

The loader no longer imports `navimower-map-card-v034.js`. This gives beta7 a new browser module URL and leaves `navimower-map-card-v034.js` free for a future stable release.

## Preserved behavior

- Beta4 automatic-height and full-width Sections defaults remain enabled.
- Completed-session SVG archives, map outlines, fixed-size zone markers, controls, and history remain unchanged.
- The schedule dialog still shows the Saved confirmation for 2.5 seconds before closing.
- Existing YAML color values remain compatible; only the duplicated manual HEX visual-editor inputs are removed.

## Testing requested

Install beta7 from HACS, refresh the frontend or restart the Home Assistant app, then verify both existing and newly added Navimower Map cards in dashboard edit mode.
